answer: A fresh account is no instant haven of trust: it must post a refundable stake bond that unlocks only as independent peers attest to real work across many epochs. Reputation climbs in a slow spiral, ring by ring, never minted in bulk. A clone fleet earns no shortcut here, since each fake funds its own collateral and waits its own vesting window, so the cost of faking N identities scales linearly. One correlated plume of lockstep-funded sockpuppets betrays itself and forfeits every stake.
